findings.source_locator: hilbert-curve.tex lines 117–126, purported vernacular continuity condition
findings.source_issue: The source asks for an input interval near some parameter whose image lies near each selected target point. Continuity instead fixes an input parameter first and requires nearby input parameters to have nearby outputs. The source's intuitive word smooth also exceeds the actual continuous-curve definition.
findings.minimal_treatment: Keep the source's proposed condition as an attributed statement and disclose that it is not the continuity criterion; use continuous rather than smooth as the mathematical property.
